stories.name: Middle East market volatility
stories.blurb: Ongoing market swings driven by Middle East tensions, oil price moves, and uncertainty over the Strait of Hormuz.

stories.name: Intel-SK Hynix Ohio Deal
stories.blurb: Intel is reportedly in talks with SK Hynix to manufacture memory chips at Intel's underused Ohio fab, boosting Intel's stock alongside a separate $15 billion capital raise for AI chip growth.

stories.name: AMD stock surge
stories.blurb: A wave of bullish coverage argues AMD's AI and Microsoft partnership will drive its stock sharply higher, even as its valuation climbs.

stories.name: AI memory chip selloff
stories.blurb: A sharp, spreading selloff in AI-driven memory and chip stocks is wiping out billions in market value across the U.S. and Asia.

stories.name: Intel Turnaround Rally
stories.blurb: Intel's stock and analyst sentiment have been rallying on optimism that its turnaround strategy and AI-driven demand are gaining traction ahead of and following Q2 earnings.

stories.name: Meta Muse AI Chip Rally
stories.blurb: Meta's new Muse AI agent sparked expectations of increased CPU demand, sending Intel, AMD, and Arm shares sharply higher amid broader moves in the AI chip sector.

rel.why: Meta's Muse AI agent is driving CPU demand bets that directly move Intel's stock and competitive position versus AMD, Arm, and Nvidia.

stories.name: ASML AI chip demand
stories.blurb: ASML is ramping up EUV lithography production and attracting investor attention as surging AI chip demand drives competition among major semiconductor players.

stories.name: AI Chip Market Growth
stories.blurb: A collection of market reports highlighting how AI, 5G, and edge computing are driving rapid growth across semiconductors, chipsets, and related hardware markets where Intel competes.

past.name: Apple Ditching Qualcomm
past.blurb: Apple is gradually replacing Qualcomm's modem chips with its own in-house designs, raising questions about Qualcomm's future revenue and stock performance.

past.name: Tech Stocks Roundup
past.blurb: A collection of general technology and semiconductor sector stock market news covering analyst ratings, price movements, and company performance across various firms including HPE, BlackBerry, and Cer

5.text: Middle East tensions and failed U.S.-Iran peace talks pushed oil above $100, raised bond yields, and pressured stocks, while peace hopes later lifted indexes and mega-cap tech. Intel isn't named in these articles, so they bear on it only through broad tech-sector and market-wide moves.

4.text: Intel may gain an outside customer for its next process by 2027 and a partner to help fund constrained Arizona fabs, while expanding Edge AI with Advantech. SK Hynix could partner on U.S. memory production and IPO its Solidigm unit near $150B.

11.text: AMD crossed a $1 trillion market cap after a roughly 190–290% year-to-date rally driven by data center and AI accelerator chips. Intel CEO Lip-Bu Tan said Intel can meet only 50% of server CPU demand, a supply shortage benefiting AMD too.

6.text: Chip stocks fell on AI safety fears after OpenAI halted training its latest models, then rebounded with Intel and AMD lifting SOXX toward its best month since June. Micron earnings are the next demand read; Intel otherwise appears mainly in sector-wide moves.

7.text: Intel stock has surged 220–334% over the past year on AI-driven demand, 18A process progress, foundry expansion, and improved factory economics and server share. Analysts debate whether the rally has fully priced in the turnaround, with a recent 5.4% pullback and targets near $141–150.

8.text: Meta's Muse AI agent sparked a chip rally, with AMD and Intel shares rising up to 17% on bets that agentic AI will drive much higher server CPU demand. Bank of America raised its AMD target to $720, projecting a $211 billion server CPU market by 2030, while keeping Intel at Buy.

12.text: ASML holds a monopoly on leading-edge chipmaking machines, while Nvidia captures most AI chip profits and TSMC may claim more. ASE Technology is expanding CoWoS and panel-level packaging on rising AI infrastructure demand. Intel is not mentioned.

13.text: Market reports project growth in AI, edge, photonic, RF, WiFi, and next-generation computing chip segments, naming Intel among benchmarked or profiled vendors. Intel is otherwise barely mentioned, appearing only as a listed player and as prior employer of Gunnison Copper's new CFO.
